mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnostic_report(id, user_id, uploaded_at, json_bytes, compressed_report) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, clock_timestamp(), #{size}, #{gzip})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM diagnostic_report WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM diagnostic_report ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC, id DESC OFFSET 32)
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, u.nickname, r.uploaded_at AS uploadedAt, r.json_bytes AS byteSize FROM diagnostic_report r JOIN app_user u ON u.id = r.user_id ORDER BY r.uploaded_at DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT compressed_report FROM diagnostic_report WHERE id = #{id}
